head_commit.message:
docs(tui): clarify legacy approval bridging behavior

Document the non-obvious compatibility behavior in `tui_app_server`.
The added comments explain how legacy approval requests are bridged
into the v2 UI path, why resolution preserves the original wire
format, and why resolved approvals must be scrubbed from buffered,
queued, replay, and modal state.

This keeps the PR easier to review without changing runtime behavior
or broadening documentation beyond the new compatibility paths.
